data.one_liner: Manages smooth switching between keyboard and custom panels on chat pages.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter package designed for managing the bottom container of a chat page. It facilitates smooth switching between the software keyboard and other custom panels like emojis or tools.
use_when: You are building a chat application and need smooth transitions between the keyboard and custom bottom panels.
You want to avoid jarring layout jumps when switching input methods on chat screens.
avoid_when: You are building a standard app without chat inputs or bottom panels.
You do not need custom panel management below the text input.
strengths: Enables smooth switching between keyboard and custom panels.
Supports custom animations and panel types.
Cross-platform support including iOS, Android, and OpenHarmony/HarmonyOS.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration such as setting resizeToAvoidBottomInset to false.
Android integration requires adding jitpack to the root build.gradle.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting resizeToAvoidBottomInset to false in Scaffold, and adding jitpack repository to Android's build.gradle.
